Maharashtra significantly increased its share of the pipeline, indicating a focus on regional development.

The manufacturing sector specifically showed promising growth, advancing from 59.5 to 61.0 this quarter. Both trading and services sectors are also experiencing a surge in positive sentiment, suggesting a bright future for all sectors amidst ongoing challenges.

articles.title: German companies plan to double, triple growth in India over 3-5 years: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: German companies are planning significant growth in India over the next three to five years. Piyush Goyal emphasized partnerships in technology co-creation and skill development for Indian youth. During his visit to Germany, he met with various industry leaders to discuss investment opportunities. There is a focus on expanding German manufacturing and research capabilities in India. Promising sectors for collaboration include electronics, automobiles, and smart manufacturing.

articles.title: India brings back duties on specified Chinese titanium dioxide imports
articles.desc: India has reintroduced anti-dumping duties on titanium dioxide imports from China due to material injury caused to domestic producers. This action follows a recommendation from the Directorate General of Trade Remedies, which concluded that Chinese imports were sold at dumped prices. The duties will be effective for five years unless revoked or amended. This decision comes after the Calcutta High Court ordered a reconsideration of a previous duty case.

articles.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to Rs 858 crore
articles.desc: AU's gross non-performing assets ratio fell 42 basis points (bps) to 1.99% at the end of September. This helped in 25% lower provision at Rs 359 crore against Rs 481 crore. Net NPA ratio improved by 7 bps to 0.81%. Annualised credit cost improved by 45 bps to 0.8% from 1.2% over the year.

articles.title: FICCI seeks Dutch investment in mfg, tech; calls for project-level follow-up
articles.desc: FICCI has called for enhanced Dutch investments in India’s manufacturing and technology sectors during Piyush Goyal's visit. The discussions may lead to manufacturing partnerships and technology collaborations which would strengthen bilateral trade. Greater emphasis is placed on supply chain integration to meet Dutch quality and sustainability standards. The upcoming India-EU free trade agreement is expected to facilitate deeper commercial ties.
